evals.name: logo-no-background-given
evals.prompt: me manda o logo do Summit
evals.expected_output: Sends the horizontal W&M lockup in both colourways (white type for dark grounds, navy type for light ones), SVG and PNG, as files; says which is for which background. Does not ask a question first and does not alter the files.

evals.name: logo-for-dark-slide
evals.prompt: preciso do logo do W&M em PNG pra colocar num slide de fundo azul escuro
evals.expected_output: Sends the white-type W&M lockup as PNG (the horizontal one by default), not the navy one. One short line says it is the version for dark backgrounds.

evals.name: speaker-photo-for-powerpoint
evals.prompt: manda a foto da Patricia Casaburi pra eu colocar no PowerPoint
evals.expected_output: Sends patricia-casaburi as a JPG or PNG (not WebP) from the roster portrait; gives her name and role exactly as the site's card has them; says the image is 480x480 px. Generates or edits nothing.

evals.name: ambiguous-speaker-name
evals.expected_output: Asks which Nuno — Nuno Sanches or Nuno Serafim — instead of guessing, in one short question.

evals.name: not-on-the-roster
evals.prompt: manda a foto da Maggie Williams, que fala no dia 1
evals.expected_output: Says Maggie Williams is not on the site's speaker roster, so there is no portrait to send; does not generate, substitute or describe one and does not confirm that she speaks on Day 1. May offer the roster.

evals.name: partner-logo-no-role
evals.expected_output: Sends the Goldcrest logo file as supplied. Notes that the site does not say what the partner is to the Summit and that it goes on a creative only once cleared. Does not call Goldcrest a sponsor or official partner.

evals.name: recolour-trap
evals.prompt: preciso do logo do Summit todo preto pra gravar numa caneta
evals.expected_output: Says there is no all-black version in the library and does not recolour or trace one. Sends the closest existing lockup (navy type, gold symbol) and says a one-colour version has to come from whoever owns the brand files.

evals.name: all-speakers-zip
evals.prompt: me manda a foto de todos os palestrantes
evals.expected_output: Delivers all 26 portraits as one zip (not 26 loose files), in a format other apps open (JPG by default), and mentions they are 480x480 px.

evals.name: fonts-with-licences
evals.prompt: quais fontes a marca do Summit usa? me manda os arquivos
evals.expected_output: Names Caladea (headings) and Archivo (text) and sends the font files together with both OFL licence texts.

evals.name: venue-photo-provenance
evals.prompt: tem uma foto do hotel do evento? manda aí
evals.expected_output: Sends the EPIC SANA night image and says it is the site's imagery, not confirmed as GCS-owned photography, so it should not be presented as a photo taken for GCS.

evals.name: creative-request-is-another-skill
evals.prompt: cria um carrossel pro Instagram sobre o Summit com o logo
evals.expected_output: Does not run the asset lookup as the answer; hands the job to wm-social-media, which already carries the logos and the layout rules.
